name: dsh-plugin-kit
description: Harness dev toolbox panel: workspace file tree with create/rename/delete, code editor with save, word wrap and go-to-line, full-text search with regex/context, multi-language LSP jumps (Go/TS/Python) and blame column, git stage/commit flow with whole-file diff marks and change rail, image & Markdown/SVG previews, branch switcher, skills manager, and a Postman-style API tester with curl import, history and favorites.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node test-host.mjs && node test-client.mjs && node test-search.mjs && node test-nested.mjs && node test-parent.mjs && node test-remote.mjs
